name: Dockpeek
description: A lightweight, self-hosted Docker dashboard that provides quick access to all running containers and their exposed ports with one-click access to web apps.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Secret key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-dockpeek application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-dockpeek
  # The `big-bear-dockpeek` service definition
  big-bear-dockpeek:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-dockpeek
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: ghcr.io/dockpeek/dockpeek:v1.7.3@sha256:eb3f6ebf64a1775f22873e01cd25d2543da94a2743bbf7b005cf13e9bc171360
    # Environment variables
    environment:
      # Secret key for the application (change this)
      SECRET_KEY: ${SECRET_SECRET_KEY}
      # Username for authentication (change this)
      USERNAME: "bigbear"
      # Password for authentication (change this)
      PASSWORD: ${SECRET_PASSWORD}
      # Docker host configuration
      DOCKER_HOST: "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8000"
